thresholds.status: post hoc interpretive thresholds, not gates

definitions.trim: constant phase per channel at f0 for the REQUIRED step q*tau_req(theta0) (pcttd.subarray.retrim) applied to Phase 4 H_raw; delay slope untouched
definitions.ideal_sub: ideal TTD between subarrays, fixed-phase intra-subarray weights (Phase 6 ideal_sub)
definitions.analytic_law: sin(theta_pk) - sin(theta0) = (f0/f - 1) sin(theta0) (1 - rho), rho = q_phc/q_req (same as Phase 6 6a_subarrays.py)
definitions.match: Msub sin(theta)/2 = k f0 tau_PhC; k = number of PhC periods per adjacent subarray delay increment (k > 1 not simulated)
definitions.power: |AF|^2/N_el^2; window = 1/(2 fmax Msub d_e); 40001-pt sin grid; band 0.231-0.268
